card.title: Screening A[i]gent
card.summary: Replaces fast, inconsistent resume skims with rubric-driven evaluation. Every application gets the same deep dive, an explainable recommendation, and structured outputs that clean up downstream hiring signals.

card.title: Pipeline A[i]gent
card.summary: Monitors funnel metrics in the background and surfaces bottlenecks before KPIs slip. Prepares corrective action plans automatically, saving recruiting leaders 4–8 hours of manual analysis every week.

card.title: Planning A[i]gent
card.summary: Converts hiring goals into stage-by-stage weekly volume. Applications, screens, HM interviews, offers — so teams can see where the plan breaks before the quarter does.

card.title: Attribution A[i]gent
card.summary: Cookie-based view-through attribution that credits every sourcing channel and automates referral bonus tracking.

card.title: Scoring A[i]gent
card.summary: Captures candidate behavioral signals, scoring them across four I/O psychology constructs, and surfaces the results inside the ATS. Evaluation becomes evidence-based, not instinct-based.

card.title: Insight A[i]gent
card.summary: Checks institutional memory before escalating anything, routes net-new ideas to the right owner with context attached, and responds to employees immediately. Good ideas don't die in the space between insight and response.

card.title: Headcount A[i]gent
card.summary: Turns headcount approvals into locked timeline commitments — synced automatically between HRIS and ATS so finance, HR, and recruiting always work from the same intelligent plan.

card.title: Referral A[i]gent
card.summary: Surfaces employee network matches against open reqs and turns a Slack nudge into a ready-to-send referral — before a connection slips through.

card.title: Employee Listening A[i]gent
card.summary: Transforms qualitative signals into measurable workflow insights.

card.title: Sourcing A[i]gent
card.summary: Improves response rates while reducing wasted outreach.
